caption: F. Edenden, “Females and males of the winter moth,” fig. 37 from Fred. V. Theobald, The Insect and Other Allied Pests of Orchard, Bush and Hothouse Fruits (1909), p. 51, photograph
alt: A photograph of four pinned moths on a pale ground: on the right, two males with broad, finely barred grey-brown wings spread wide; on the left, two much smaller females, dark and spidery, with only stubs where wings should be.
bibliography: Edenden, F. “Females and males of the winter moth.” Fig. 37 in Fred. V. Theobald, The Insect and Other Allied Pests of Orchard, Bush and Hothouse Fruits, 1909, p. 51.
title: Females and males of the winter moth
